newsitem.title: USA: Forty-five charged in securities case - US attorney.
newsitem.headline: Forty-five charged in securities case - US attorney.

text.p: The Manhattan U.S. Attorney's office said Thursday it will hold a news conference at 1430 EDT/1830 GMT to announce securities fraud charges against 45 individuals following an investigation of alleged illegal payments made to stockbrokers nationwide in connection with sales of over-the counter and NASDAQ stocks.
Officials from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and the Federal Bureau of Investigation will be involved in the conference, prosecutors said.
No other details were immediately available.
On Sept. 27, the SEC sued stock promoter Atlantic Capital Corp of Orlando and seven stockbrokers for a scheme in which the brokers were allegedly bribed to recommend certain stocks.
The civil suit, filed in federal court in Orlando, Fla., alleged that the promoter netted about $2.6 million from the scheme.
A lawyer with the SEC would not comment as to whether Thursday's case involved the Atlantic Capital proceeding. REUTER
